**Summary:** briefly describe the procedural change you wish to make

## Issue

Describe in detail the issue, as you see it, with the current procedures, if they exist.

## Proposed Change

Describe in detail your proposal for resolving the aforementioned issue. Include information as to how your proposal addresses this issue, any unknown or unhandled edge cases your proposal has, and how your proposal may be put into effect.

## Porposal Status

- [ ] Proposal has been discussed by team and community
- [ ] Proposal has been moved forward for approval
  - [ ] Proposal has been approved
  - [ ] Proposal has been denied
